Roles and permissions

Applicants can view their own application. Referees can upload one reference to their invitation. Assigned panelists see their review packet. The coordinator releases awards.

Build prompt

Build “Scholarship, Bursary, or Micro-Grant Portal” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Set a submission deadline and distinguish incomplete applications from ready ones. Collect rubric scores and conflict-of-interest declarations. Withhold confidential references from applicants. Applicants can view their own application. Referees can upload one reference to their invitation. Assigned panelists see their review packet. The coordinator releases awards. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

A file with a missing reference remains incomplete. Adding the invited reference makes it ready. A panelist who declares a conflict cannot score it and the coordinator can assign a replacement.
